summary: Cloud platform for running web scraping and automation Actors with a large store of ready-made tools.
access_note: Free plan with $5 monthly usage; token created in Console Integrations.

evidence.quote: You can create an API token on the Integrations page in the Apify Console.
The recommended remote connection signs you in with OAuth instead.
Start for free No credit card required.
The API is organized around RESTful HTTP endpoints.
On first connection, your browser opens so you can sign in to Apify and approve access.

notes: REST API uses API tokens (Bearer or query); OAuth applies to hosted MCP server sign-in at https://mcp.apify.com. Free plan includes $5 monthly usage credit.

review.from: auth quote had markdown link syntax; access quote did not show free signup
review.reason: Auth quote did not match raw HTML; access quote only described free-plan limits, now shows free signup with no card.
